# YouTube Official Blog

> > The official blog covering YouTube product launches, creator programs, live streaming events, and platform innovations.

This blog chronicles YouTube's evolution from 2010-2017, documenting major product releases like YouTube Red and YouTube Go, the expansion of YouTube Spaces for creators, partnerships with music festivals and news organizations like VICE News, and features supporting citizen journalism through CitizenTube. It showcases YouTube's commitment to creators, safety, and global expansion.

## Key Topics

- YouTube Spaces (New York, London, Los Angeles, Tokyo)
- Live streaming events and festivals
- Creator facilities and production resources
- CitizenTube and citizen journalism
- YouTube Red subscription service
- YouTube Go for emerging markets
- Mobile app features and updates
- Content creator community
- YouTube Nonprofit Program
- Music partnerships and festivals (Coachella, Laneway)
- Safety and privacy tools (face blurring)
- Video marketing strategies
- Global platform expansion
- News coverage and human rights
- AdBlitz and advertising campaigns

## Product Launches & Platform Features

- [Meet YouTube Red, the ultimate YouTube experience](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/red): YouTube Red subscription service launch with ad-free and offline features
- [YouTube Go beta launches in India](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/youtube-go-beta-launches-in-india): YouTube Go beta launch in India with offline viewing and data controls
- [Face blurring: when footage requires anonymity](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/face-blurring-when-footage-requires): Face blurring feature launch for privacy protection in activist footage
- [Play on, player, with the updated YouTube apps for Android and iOS](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/play-on-player-with-updated-youtube): YouTube mobile app update with picture-in-picture and Chromecast support
- [Safer Internet Day Tips From YouTube](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/safer-internet-day-tips-from-youtube): Safer Internet Day safety tools and community guidelines overview

## News, Journalism & Social Impact

- [VICE News launches on YouTube](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/vice-brings-24-hour-news-to-youtube): VICE News channel launch covering international news and citizen journalism
- [Technology and human rights](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/technology-and-human-rights): RightsCon coverage on technology's role in human rights and free expression
- [An update to the YouTube Nonprofit Program goes live](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/update-to-youtube-nonprofit-program): YouTube Nonprofit Program update with live streaming and donation features
- [Bahrain Grand Prix, France goes to run-off ballot, Plane crash in Pakistan](https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/bahrain-grand-prix-france-goes-to-run): CitizenTube weekly news recap covering global events and citizen journalism
